zh: 皮肤里所有动效的时长、曲线、位移与模糊改由一份动效令牌表（`packages/client/src/theme/tokens.json` 的 `motion` 一组）统一给出，同一作用的数值合成一档：颜色与背景反馈统一到 0.12 秒，面板、搜索卡片与提示条统一到 0.15 秒（退场 0.12 秒），文字换词统一到 0.15 秒、两个半段间隔 0.05 秒，数字翻页统一到 0.16 秒。少数交互的节奏随之变化：推理等级数值换词由 0.28 秒变 0.15 秒，搜索面板进场由 0.18 秒变 0.15 秒、退场由 0.14 秒变 0.12 秒，封号提示条由 6 像素位移改为 4 像素，视图标签的悬停颜色由 0.2 秒变 0.12 秒，侧栏图标转四分之一圈由 0.25 秒变 0.24 秒。文档里的动效表由同一份数据生成（`docs/STYLE.md`），构建会拒绝样式表里直接写出的时长与曲线、内容重复的关键帧，以及没有读者认领的动效令牌。
en: Every duration, curve, distance and blur in the skin now comes from one motion token table (the `motion` group of `packages/client/src/theme/tokens.json`), with one value per role: colour and background feedback at 0.12 s, surfaces — panels, the search card, toasts — at 0.15 s and their dismissal at 0.12 s, wording swaps at 0.15 s with 0.05 s between the two halves, and a figure's digits rolling over in 0.16 s. A few interactions changed pace with it: the reasoning-effort wording swap went from 0.28 s to 0.15 s, the search card enters in 0.15 s (was 0.18 s) and leaves in 0.12 s (was 0.14 s), the ban toast travels 4px instead of 6px, the view tabs' hover colour takes 0.12 s (was 0.2 s), and a sidebar icon's quarter turn takes 0.24 s (was 0.25 s). The style guide's motion table is generated from the same data, and the build refuses a duration or curve written straight into a stylesheet, keyframes that repeat one the skin already has, and a motion token nothing reads.
